description:
System-level wiring/interconnection GA titled “SW 108-01 - Wiring Schematic” for a Termodinamica marine inverter air-conditioning installation. Two engine-room VRV18E1 units (PORT and STBD) are each supplied from a Main Switchboard via a 40 amp C or D curve breaker (B1), grounded to the compressor ground, and each feeds a SEA WATER PUMP TMD100. The PORT VRV18E1 connects by BUS MASTER LINE 1 to a Switch BUS Box Connection; the STBD VRV18E1 connects by BUS MASTER LINE 2 to the same switch bus box, forming the main control bus between the two engine-room units and the distributed equipment. An INTERNET ROUTER provides Ethernet LAN to the TMD Internet Interface and to Touch Screen 7. The TMD Internet Interface is powered at 80 W @ 24 VDC. Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 is powered at 10 W @ 24 VDC and links into the bus/touchscreen network.

PORT-side/top equipment chain, with local 230 VAC supply drops and thermostat/control links shown: MRM­AXI18i Fwd Guest cabin Addr.2; MRM­AXI30i Salon port Addr.3; MRM­AXI18i Aft Guest cabin port Addr.4; MRM­AXI30i Fwd Galley Addr.5.0; MRM­AXI30i Aft Galley Addr.5.1; MRM­AXI18i Aft Crew cabin port Addr.6; AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS Addr.31, model QI-50-V-485; and TMD Bridge Addr.32 with RS485 Modbus RTU. Thermostat boxes marked “Therm” connect to the associated fan-coil units. The top fan-coil/control group is linked by the pink BUS SLAVE LINE and blue 230 VAC supply line, with orange bus/power interconnects shown along the bottoms of units.

STBD-side/bottom equipment chain: Touch Screen Interface Addr.1; MRM­AXI18i Aft Crew cabin stbd Addr.7; MRM­AXI18i Fwd Crew cabin stbd Addr.8; MRM­AXI18i Aft Guest cabin stbd Addr.9; MRM­AXI30i Salon stbd Addr.10; MRM­AXI30i Owner’s cabin Addr.11; AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS Addr.31, model QI-50-V-485; and TMD Bridge Addr.32 with RS485 Modbus RTU. Each fan-coil has a “Therm” control where drawn and a 230 VAC drop. Pink bus-slave wiring loops around and interconnects the upper and lower distributed groups.

Inset detail drawings at right show: SxythSense Touch Screen Connection; VRV18E1 Terminal Block Connection; Sxythsense Touch Screen & SubSlave Air Handler Connection; Air Handler Wiring; Air Handler Port and Stbd Connection; Air Handler Master and Slave Air Handler Connection; TSTE 7” Exor Touch Screen & Dual Touch Screen Interfaces Connection; AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod. QI-50-V-485; and Switch BUS Box Connection. Key line indicates green main-switchboard compressor power supply 230 VAC, red sea-water-pump supply, blue 230 VAC power supply, orange BUS MASTER LINE 1, brown BUS MASTER LINE 2, magenta BUS SLAVE LINE, pale green Ethernet cable UTP CAT.5, and compressor ground wire. Zones/locations explicitly represented include Engine Room PORT/STBD, Fwd/Aft Guest cabins port/stbd, Salon port/stbd, Fwd/Aft Galley, Aft Crew cabin port/stbd, Fwd Crew cabin stbd, and Owner’s cabin.
